name: Arbhar expander
source: Arbhar-Manual-Firmware-1.6.a.pdf p.7 (CV Expansion Module panel and key)
notes: 2HP CV Expansion Module included with Arbhar, connects via ribbon to the main module. Panel prints SPRAY, LAYER, DUB, MOD, D / W; jacks 3-5 are icon-only (Grain Direction %, Grain Window, Pitch Deviation), named here from the manual key. MOD CV input's function depends on the configuration/alt modes set in firmware 1.6.
